description: This file defines a Flutter StatefulWidget called RecipeFormScreen, which provides a form interface for creating and editing recipes. It handles form input, ingredient/step/tag management, and interaction with a RecipeProvider to persist data.

classes.name: RecipeFormScreen
classes.description: Main widget class for the recipe form screen, extending StatefulWidget.

classes.name: _RecipeFormScreenState
classes.description: State class handling the form's internal logic, UI, and user interactions.

methods.name: didChangeDependencies
methods.description: Loads existing recipe data when navigating to edit an existing recipe.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes of text controllers to free resources.

methods.name: _addIngredient
methods.description: Displays a dialog to add a new ingredient to the recipe.

methods.name: _addStep
methods.description: Displays a dialog to add a new preparation step.

methods.name: _addTag
methods.description: Displays a dialog to add a new tag.

methods.name: _save
methods.description: Validates the form, constructs a Recipe object, and saves it via the provider.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI of the recipe form, including form fields, ingredients, steps, tags, and save button.
